name: Octree Node Lookup by Voxel
definition: Traverses the SVO from the root to find the payload index for a specific voxel coordinate. It uses child masks and prefix ranks to navigate internal nodes and locate leaf nodes.
summary: Octree Node Lookup by Voxel traverses a Sparse Voxel Octree to return a payload index for a 3D coordinate, differing from color retrieval by providing only the index rather than interpolated data.
